title: Encoding a List of Algebraic Gates
statement: For any list $g_1,\ldots,g_m$ of algebraic gates, its encoding is the concatenation of the marker bit $1$ followed by the encoding of each gate, in order, and a final marker bit $0$.
hypotheses_covered: The list consists of algebraic gates over $n$ input variables
